day.headline: A Dragon day — Rat and Monkey are in step.

reasons: Rooster pairs with Dragon — a harmonious day
signs.message: Refresh once more, then act on whatever it says.

reasons: Rat and Dragon share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Twelve flights, zero witnesses. Take them fast, arrive weirdly awake.

reasons: Rabbit sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: The one you never wear because it's too much. Wear it.

reasons: Horse sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.message: Leave dinner open till seven, then say yes fast.

reasons: Monkey and Dragon share a triad — strong alignment today
signs.message: Decline the weekly one this once. Nobody's defending it.

reasons: Dragon's own day — your energy runs high
signs.motif: the jacket bought for a different life
signs.message: Try that jacket on tonight, then decide if it stays.

reasons: Dog opposes Dragon — a day to take slowly
signs.message: Just ask what you're looking at. One line, no theories.

reasons: Ox sits apart from Dragon — the day is yours to steer
signs.motif: a green light you did not expect
